I don't see any medications on your chart that I can refill right now. If you'd like to speak with our patient support team about this, just let me know.
Oh, that’s odd. I’ve definitely had meloxicam from you before. Could you check again or connect me with someone who can help?

Uh, hello? That’s strange. I’m still here and I need that refill.
